arStrings.szText: Killing an enemy grants {c_number}[Affix_Value_1|%|*100]{/c} Resource Cost Reduction and {c_number}[Affix_Value_2|%|*100]{/c} Movement Speed for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"]{/c} seconds. While this is active, more kills increase the duration of this by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} second but the duration cannot go above {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} seconds.
